title: Daedra
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. Atronachs are not part of the census. Creation Club Daedra sit on their kind's page (The Cause and Arms of Chaos Dremora on *Dremora* and *Unique Dremora*, Saints & Seducers on *Golden Saints & Dark Seducers*, the Shadowrend Shadow on *Shadow*). Daedra that exist only as summons are under Conjured. The Daedric Princes' mortal followers and quest foes are filed here too, from *The Afflicted* on.

families.holds: the Dremora ladder (Churl 6 · Caitiff 12 · Kynval 19 · Kynreeve 27 · Markynaz 36 · Valkynaz 46) in its melee, missile and warlock lines, and the Unbound Dremora
the named Dremora: Velehk Sain, The Cause's Valkyn Gatanas and Valkyn Methats, and the three Arms of Chaos Dremora (Sovereign, Sehtkynaz, Lyrkynaz)
the Seeker ladder (Seeker 21 · Seeker Aspirant 32 · High Seeker 42), `DLC2LCharSeeker` and its Apocrypha wrappers, the MQ02 High Seekers and the Seekers' mirror images
the Lurker ladder (Lurker 24 · Guardian 34 · Sentinel 44 · Vindicator 54), `DLC2LCharLurker` and its wrappers, and the Lurker that rises from a freed standing stone
Saints & Seducers: the hostile Golden Saints and Dark Seducers that Balance of Power spawns, and Staada
the Shadowrend CC pack's Shadow, a mirror of the player that keeps scaling with the player (an exception to bone 1)
Peryite's Afflicted (`DA13`): the melee, magic and missile ladders 1 · 5 · 9 · 14 · 19 · 24, the world-encounter Remnants and Refugee, and Orchendor
the `DA02` cultists and the world-encounter cultist (bandit ladders), the CC Goldbrand cultists, and the Champion of Boethiah (Briarheart ladder)
the `DA05` hunters of Bloated Man's Grotto (bandit ladder; J'Kier 1)
The Cause's Mythic Dawn cultists, explorers and guards (bandit rungs 9 · 14 · 19 · 25) and Vonos (Conjurer boss rungs 14 · 21 · 30 · 40)
the `DA16` Nightcaller Temple foes: the Devotees (Storm Mage ladder), the Orcish Invaders, Veren Duleri and Thorek
the one-offs: Namira's cannibals (Eola, Nimphaneth, Sanyon), Molag Bal's Logrolf the Willful, Clavicus Vile's Sebastian Lort and Meridia's Malkoran and his Shade
